composite.name: QBench External Composite
composite.method: Exact model-name intersection across the five benchmark families. Preserve each source's published 0–100 score; FrontierMath family score is the arithmetic mean of Tiers 1–3 (v2) and Tier 4 (v2), so the two tiers count as one family. The composite is the equal-weight arithmetic mean of LiveBench 2.0, GPQA Diamond, FrontierMath family, ProofBench and Furniture Assembly. This is a descriptive external composite, not a universal capability measure or a QBench-run score. SWE-bench snapshots remain separate because their model coverage is not the same exact-match composite cohort.
